title: Build the Mez Systems global navigation and Explore menu
objective: Maintain the canonical Global Navigation 1.0.0 promoted from the mez-explore-menu research: one compact parent bar, one expanded five-product Living Registry, complete accessibility and responsive behaviour, canonical product data and a portable component release.

included: five-circle family stack inside the Explore trigger
calm eased disclosure and restrained item entrance
real destinations supplied by an authorised consumer
five automatically animated spherical Living Cores while expanded
excluded: golden homepage layout beyond the navigation host slot

acceptance: one canonical navigation contract owns semantics, anatomy, variants, sizes, states, content limits, responsive behaviour, accessibility, motion, events and prohibited uses
the approved direction consumes canonical products and foundations without copied identity values
all five spherical Living Cores animate automatically while the expanded registry is visible and hover only changes field speed
reduced-motion and runtime-failure modes preserve five exact static circular twins
research-only variants remain evidence rather than parallel production components
compact, expanded, selected, keyboard, mobile, reduced-motion and failure states remain reviewable as a locked proof
realistic long product names and mixed lifecycle states fit
the component has zero horizontal page overflow from 320 through 1440 pixels
the approved component installs without the canonical checkout
static HTML and the primary consumer framework share one versioned behavioural contract
component CSS and code expose no hidden copied product, token or gradient values

verification.passCondition: products, assignments, Wings, foundations, Living Core renderer and EXP-07 motion rules remain immutable
keyboard order, focus visibility, Escape, outside click, focus restoration, landmark semantics and touch targets pass
all five spherical Living Cores move automatically while expanded; hover only changes field speed; the menu transition is user-triggered, interruptible and equivalent under reduced motion
compact and expanded states recompose without overflow at every named viewport
a clean fixture consumes the packaged component without source-repository access
Olli approves one primary navigation family and its bounded variants

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Does this five-sphere Living Registry feel unmistakably Mez, make the family easy to understand and remain controlled enough to frame every website?

stopConditions: any of the five product spheres waits for hover before animating
the task promotes multiple visual experiments as parallel production components
navigation destinations are fabricated without consumer authority
the five-live-sphere exception is silently applied outside the bounded expanded navigation
the task expands into the golden homepage, authenticated application shell, Figma or consumer migration
research code is described as canonical before the human gate
notes: The existing dependency-free <mez-explore-menu> remains substantial research evidence, not an independent source of truth.
Global Navigation 1.0.0 canonically promotes the quiet Living Registry family; Signal, Aperture, Gallery and Console remain research evidence.
Round 02 followed Olli's explicit request for all five materials to animate automatically and use sphere geometry.
Round 03 added a layered stack of five static product circles to the compact Explore systems trigger.
Round 04 removed the instructional footer and replaced the faster disclosure with a calm eased shell expansion and restrained five-item entrance.
Olli approved Round 04 on 23 July 2026 through DEC-GLOBAL-NAVIGATION-COMPONENT-001.
The five-live-sphere exception is canonical only inside the bounded expanded navigation and does not rewrite DEC-WEBSITE-MOTION-SYSTEM-001 elsewhere.
